three.js 0.160.1
https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.1/build/three.module.min.js

Vendored as a single self-contained ES module: it has no top-level
imports, so the page can map the bare specifier "three" to it with an
import map and the browser loads the whole library in one request.

Upgrade by replacing the file and this note together; vstatic() derives
the cache-busting hash from the file contents.
